g.text: Inside one request: prefill, then decode
What one accelerator does with a 20,000-token prompt
One accelerator · GPU or Trainium2 chip
HBM · 80–192 GB stacked on the same package
keys and values for every token,
every layer, of every live request
Prefill processes all 20,000 tokens in parallel: compute bound.
Decode makes one token per step and re-reads the weights plus the whole KV cache from HBM each time: memory-bandwidth bound.
That's why HBM size and bandwidth (H200 4.8 TB/s, Trainium2 ~2.9 TB/s) decide how many users one chip can serve.
